description: This file appears to be a main script for a bot implementation that integrates various components including speech activity detection (VAD), language model interaction (Google Gemini), and a pipeline framework, to enable a live video/audio interaction system. It sets up transports, defines event handlers, and orchestrates the flow of data between components.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: A class representing the context of the language model, holding conversational state.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: A class for managing pairs of aggregators for LLM context and responses.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: A class representing a sequence of processing steps for streaming data.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: A class representing a task that runs a pipeline with specific parameters and timeout.

classes.name: PipelineParams
classes.description: A class holding configuration parameters for pipeline execution.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: A class for executing a pipeline, managing signals and lifecycle.

classes.name: BaseTransport
classes.description: Abstract class or interface for transport implementations handling communication.

classes.name: TransportParams
classes.description: Class encapsulating parameters for transport configuration.

methods.description: Main function that sets up the pipeline, transport, and event handlers, then runs the bot.
